reviews.title: sudoku
reviews.text: i enjoy playing sudoku lots, so when i noticed this game had that as an option, obviously i played. i played hard mode and every single time without fail, i found it impossible to play. within about seven minutes of the game every time, there would come a box where all empty slots disallow a number to be there. it was frustrating, to say the least. if you plan to play sudoku on this app, either find a new one or don’t play hard mode (i never tried easy or medium so i can’t speak for those). for the record, over half of the number are already there  in hard mode, so i can only imagine that how much is there for the easier modes. the hard mode in this game is the easy mode i play online.
